company.name: Circumvent
company.description: Circumvent Pharmaceuticals is seeking to address the significant unmet need of neurodegenerative disease patients. Circumvent is targeting heritable forms of neurodegeneration to enable drug discovery and development in both rare and common forms of neurodegenerative disease. Circumvent is funded by NIH/NINDS, YC Bio, Heritage Provider Network, the Longevity Fund, and additional investors.

productsAndServices.description: Development of targeted therapies for neurodegenerative diseases, initially focusing on Batten Disease, to address underlying biological mechanisms.
productsAndServices.name: Precision Medicines for Neurodegenerative Diseases
